from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollmentData(BaseModel):
    """One university's enrollment and admission statistics from a single report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    admitted_first_year: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time first-year students admitted")
    enrolled_first_year: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time first-year students enrolled")
    enrolled_transfer: int | None = Field(description="Number of degree-seeking transfer students enrolled")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityEnrollmentData]
